alignments.note: Substantival numeral with the generic noun the ASV supplies to complete it (rule 31) and the presentative frame the construction hands the predicate (rule 20); head stays on the numeral.
The resuming pronoun is the unrendered occurrence; the copula goes to the predicate (rules 20, 22).
The antecedent is written and the relative stands over a finite clause with no relative morpheme in it (rules 46, 55).
A second supplied relative, standing apart from the first and so its own unit (rules 2, 55).

The rectum's relation is recast as *unto* (rule 19); the noun's own lexeme is not written, as the margin's literal gloss records without deciding anything (rule 38).
